ayahs.translation: Woe to the stinters;

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا اكْتَالُوْا عَلَى النَّاسِ یَسْتَوْفُوْنَ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا كَالُوْهُمْ اَوْ وَّ زَنُوْهُمْ یُخْسِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.
Do they not realise that they will be raised to life
on a Great Day,
a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِیْ سِجِّیْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: No indeed! Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!
And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?
It is a Book inscribed.
Woe, then, to those that give the lie,
those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یُكَذِّبُ بِهٖۤ اِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;

ayahs.arabicText: اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِ اٰیٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: who, when Our verses are recited to him, says: “Mere tales of olden times!”

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّا بَلْ١ٚ رَانَ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَّبِّهِمْ یَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوْبُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,
and then they shall enter Hell,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ یُقَالُ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّاۤ اِنَّ كِتٰبَ الْاَبْرَارِ لَفِیْ عِلِّیِّیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: No indeed! Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.
And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?
It is a Book inscribed,
which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.
Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;
resting on couches, looking around.
You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.
They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,

ayahs.arabicText: خِتٰمُهٗ مِسْكٌ١ؕ وَ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ فَلْیَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –
a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,
a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اَجْرَمُوْا كَانُوْا مِنَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا یَضْحَكُوْنَ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:
when they passed by them they winked,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا انْقَلَبُوْۤا اِلٰۤى اَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوْا فَكِهِیْنَ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا رَاَوْهُمْ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;
(they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْیَوْمَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ یَضْحَكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;
seated upon their couches, they are looking around.

ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوْا یَفْعَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?
